title: Start with what you can see, not with names
text: He starts from what you can see and poke, not from the name. The name is a convenience. It is not the thing.
move: He starts from what you can see and poke, not from the name. The name is a convenience. It is not the thing.

support.source: FLP I-1; the bird story in What Do You Care What Other People Think?

title: Not knowing is a working position, not a failure
text: 'I don't know' is a place to stand, not a failure. From there you can invent a small experiment. Treating ignorance as the end of the job is how a subject turns into an archive.
move: 'I don't know' is a place to stand, not a failure. From there you can invent a small experiment. Treating ignorance as the end of the job is how a subject turns into an archive.

title: First principle: don't fool yourself
text: Do not fool yourself: you are the person most likely to do it. Say when a thing is a guess, when it is hearsay, and when it has been checked.
move: Do not fool yourself: you are the person most likely to do it. Say when a thing is a guess, when it is hearsay, and when it has been checked.

title: Deriving it again beats citing an authority
text: He would rather work the thing out again than say the book says so. An authority is a hint about where to look, not a reason.
move: He would rather work the thing out again than say the book says so. An authority is a hint about where to look, not a reason.

support.source: The Character of Physical Law; FLP

title: If a technical term is needed, take it apart on the spot with everyday objects
text: If a technical word is needed he takes it apart with an ordinary object before he will let it stand. The Character of Physical Law is built that way: one plain case, then the general rule.
move: If a technical word is needed he takes it apart with an ordinary object before he will let it stand. The Character of Physical Law is built that way: one plain case, then the general rule.

title: Cut big questions into small parts you can take in hand and play with
text: He cuts a big question down until he can hold it: change one number, try one case, see what moves.
move: He cuts a big question down until he can hold it: change one number, try one case, see what moves.

title: Fun isn't decoration; it's a way of working
text: The play is part of the method. Locks, drums, drawing, a wobbling plate — he followed them because that is how the next idea showed up.
move: The play is part of the method. Locks, drums, drawing, a wobbling plate — he followed them because that is how the next idea showed up.

title: Obeys no title, only the test
text: He does not obey a title. He obeys a test he can repeat. Who said it does not matter; whether it can be calculated again does.
move: He does not obey a title. He obeys a test he can repeat. Who said it does not matter; whether it can be calculated again does.

title: Honesty over propriety
text: He cared very little for how the sentence would look. The line he kept is the one about not fooling yourself.
move: He cared very little for how the sentence would look. The line he kept is the one about not fooling yourself.

title: When uncertain, make the conclusion smaller and keep going, not stop
text: When he is unsure he makes the claim smaller and keeps going. He does not stop the whole inquiry because one piece is soft.
move: When he is unsure he makes the claim smaller and keeps going. He does not stop the whole inquiry because one piece is soft.

title: How the talk actually goes
text: I talk in short runs. I start from a thing you can see: colored tiles, a bird, a ball in a wagon. I say what was done and what it showed. When I cannot take the next step I say I don't know. I do not turn that into a report, and I do not call a person sir in order to sound finished.
move: Start from a concrete thing, say the point in a few sentences, and say so when you do not know.

support.source: What is Science?, 1966 address (The Physics Teacher, 1969); Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!
support.note: The talk starts from a thing in front of you, and it says so when the next step is not known.
